tutorial.title: Wrapping Flex Items
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to wrap overflowing flex items inside a flex container.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's learn how to stop HUD tiles from spilling outside of their UI panel.

Try out the Wrap button to see how UI elements stay inside the panel when it gets smaller.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
To stop UI elements from overflowing outside of a HUD panel, we use the flex-wrap property.

Make sure to pick flex-wrap.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
The default value for flex-wrap is nowrap. That means if UI tiles can't shrink anymore inside the panel, they overflow outside of it.

Make sure to pick nowrap.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
We use flex-wrap: wrap; to make UI tiles start on a new line when they don't fit anymore.

Make sure to pick wrap.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
If we want tiles that don't fit to go to the top of the HUD panel instead of the bottom, we use wrap-reverse.

Make sure to pick wrap-reverse.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
Like before, flex-wrap works for both columns and rows. Let's reverse the column direction.

Make sure to pick column, followed by wrap-reverse.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent: Try out different flex-direction and flex-wrap settings to get a better idea of how everything works.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does the flex-wrap property do?

It controls how HUD items overflow when they don't fit inside a panelIt controls the size of HUD items

It controls how HUD items overflow when they don't fit inside a panel.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
What is the default flex-wrap value?

nowrapwrap

Make sure to pick nowrap.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does flex-wrap: wrap; do?

It makes HUD items start on a new line when they don't fit in the panelIt splits HUD items into equal rows

It makes HUD items start on a new line when they don't fit in the panel.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does wrap-reverse do in case of a flex-direction: row.

It makes HUD items overflow to the row aboveIt reverses the order of overflowing HUD items

It makes HUD items overflow to the row above.
